rationale: Keeps Validate classification reliable for large task diffs by draining its diagnostic file-list stream instead of terminating the producer after fifty lines. Only workflow display commands, their executable Git/shell regression evidence and generated CI bookkeeping change; product behavior is unchanged relative to v1.82.0.

summary.ru: Устранён ложный SIGPIPE при выводе большого списка файлов в классификации Validate.
summary.en: Prevented a spurious SIGPIPE when Validate previews a large changed-file list.
